ordered_diagnoses: Epithelioid malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor

s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent urinary retention and sepsis with diffuse bladder wall thickening
salient_findings: Diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the entire bladder wall
Near-complete loss of the detrusor muscle
Dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with cytological atypia
key_facts: 50-year-old man with known neurofibromatosis type 1
Multiple cutaneous neurofibromas
No history of smoking
Admitted for recurrent urinary retention and sepsis
Transurethral resection of the prostate revealed fibroleiomyomatous hyperplasia
Urinary function did not improve after transurethral resection
CT scan showed diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the entire bladder wall
Cystoprostatectomy was performed due to compromised bladder function
Bladder wall was diffusely thickened, firm, and gray-white on gross examination
Histologic evaluation revealed diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation in the superficial wall
Dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with prominent cytological atypia in the deeper wall
Tumor cells were positive for S100, p16, neurofilaments, and CD56 on immunohistochemical studies
Tumor cells were negative for pan-cytokeratin, EMA, MDM2, p63, ALK, CD117, DOG1, myogenin, desmin, and smooth muscle actin

shortlist.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and the tumor shows spindle cell proliferation with prominent cytological atypia, consistent with MPNST

shortlist.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and multiple cutaneous neurofibromas, and the tumor shows diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation

shortlist.label: Neurofibrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and the tumor shows features of a malignant spindle cell neoplasm

shortlist.label: Sarcomatous transformation of a neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and the tumor shows features of a malignant transformation of a neurofibroma

shortlist.label: Epithelioid malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and the tumor shows features of a malignant epithelioid neoplasm with spindle cell proliferation

raw.rationale: The tumor's diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation, dense perivascular spindle cell proliferation with cytological atypia, and positivity for S100 and neurofilaments are consistent with a malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor, especially in the context of neurofibromatosis type 1.

rejected.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
rejected.why: Plexiform neurofibromas are typically benign and do not exhibit the cytological atypia or infiltrative growth pattern seen in this case.

rejected.label: Neurofibrosarcoma
rejected.why: Neurofibrosarcoma is an outdated term that has been replaced by malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor, and the provided information does not distinguish it as a separate entity.

rejected.label: Sarcomatous transformation of a neurofibroma
rejected.why: While sarcomatous transformation of a neurofibroma can occur, the description provided does not specifically indicate transformation from a pre-existing neurofibroma.

rejected.label: Epithelioid malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
rejected.why: The tumor cells were negative for epithelial markers such as pan-cytokeratin and EMA, which are often positive in epithelioid malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors.
